details.key: zoom:When a meeting summary is completed
details.description: Runs the workflow automatically whenever any meeting summary is completed.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever any meeting in the account ends.

details.key: zoom:When a participant joins a meeting
details.description: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a participant joins a meeting. If a specific meeting ID is provided, runs only when a participant joins that meeting.

details.key: zoom:When a new webinar is created
details.description: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new webinar is created in the account.

details.key: zoom:When a participant joins a webinar
details.description: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a participant joins a webinar. If a specific webinar ID is provided, runs only when a participant joins that webinar.

details.key: zoom:When someone registers for the meeting
details.description: Runs the workflow automatically whenever someone registers for the selected meeting.

details.key: zoom:When someone registers for the selected webinar
details.description: Runs the workflow automatically whenever someone registers for the selected webinar.
